name: Happier Runtime Plugin
description: Local/custom Fusion adapter for a pinned Happier CLI and MCP contract
author: tcflying

executable.label: Node Executable
executable.description: Absolute path to the current Fusion Node executable. Runtime attestation rejects every other executable.

entrypoint.label: Happier CLI Entrypoint
entrypoint.description: Absolute package-dist entrypoint. It must resolve beneath an allowed source root and match the published hash.

allowedCliRoots.label: Allowed Happier Source Roots
allowedCliRoots.description: One or more absolute realpath roots allowed to contain the pinned Happier CLI entrypoint.

backend.label: Backend
backend.description: Single backend used consistently by health probes, the runtime, and the Session Connector.

activeServerId.label: Active Server Profile ID
activeServerId.description: Server profile expected by every persisted binding in this plugin configuration.

publicServerUrl.label: Public Server URL
publicServerUrl.description: Optional credential-free HTTP(S) public server URL.

webappUrl.label: Web App URL
webappUrl.description: Optional credential-free HTTP(S) Happier web app URL.

timeoutMs.label: Legacy CLI Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Fallback deadline for one-shot CLI operations.

spawnTimeoutMs.label: Process Spawn Timeout (ms)
spawnTimeoutMs.description: Deadline for proving that a child process started.

connectTimeoutMs.label: MCP Connect Timeout (ms)
connectTimeoutMs.description: Deadline for MCP initialization and capability negotiation.

toolTimeoutMs.label: MCP Tool Timeout (ms)
toolTimeoutMs.description: Deadline for non-provider-waiting CLI and MCP calls.

timeoutSeconds.label: Provider Wait Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Inner provider deadline shared by Runtime and Session Connector sends.

waitTimeoutMs.label: Outer Wait Timeout (ms)
waitTimeoutMs.description: Optional outer deadline; persistence rejects values shorter than provider wait plus grace.

waitTimeoutGraceMs.label: Wait Cleanup Grace (ms)
waitTimeoutGraceMs.description: Cleanup and transport grace added after the inner provider deadline.

maxOutputBytes.label: Maximum Output Bytes
maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum buffered bytes accepted from a CLI or MCP child process.

enableLocalRuntimeSnapshot.label: Enable Local Runtime Snapshot Extension
enableLocalRuntimeSnapshot.description: Opt in to the non-upstream Fusion local runtime snapshot extension.

enableLocalReconciliationHistory.label: Enable Local Reconciliation History Extension
enableLocalReconciliationHistory.description: Opt in to the non-upstream local history extension used for fail-closed reconciliation.

enableLocalProviderTelemetry.label: Enable Local Provider Telemetry Extension
enableLocalProviderTelemetry.description: Opt in to non-upstream local provider telemetry. It never grants dispatch readiness.

createIntentDirectory.label: Create Intent Directory
createIntentDirectory.description: Optional absolute directory for restart-durable create intents.

deliveryFenceDirectory.label: Delivery Fence Directory
deliveryFenceDirectory.description: Optional absolute directory for restart-durable localId/contentHash fences.

runtime.name: Happier Runtime
runtime.description: Local/custom adapter for pinned Happier JSON CLI sessions with durable native ids

sessionConnector.name: Happier Session Connector
sessionConnector.description: Local/custom connector for manually bound Sessions using the pinned official Happier MCP contract
